exposure: reported barriers (inadequate training, staffing, equipment, fear of litigation)
cohort: The study included 500 obstetric providers across various regions of Egypt.
finding: The study revealed critical gaps in the knowledge and practice of operative vaginal birth (OVB) among obstetric providers in Egypt, with most demonstrating low knowledge and rarely practicing OVB, primarily due to inadequate training, staffing, equipment, and fear of litigation.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal birth (OVB) was rarely practiced by obstetric providers in Egypt, with 95.8% reporting zero monthly procedures, and key barriers included inadequate training, staffing, equipment, and fear of litigation.
